READ-ONLY codebase sweep in /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa (a Salesforce PWA Kit / retail-react-app v10 storefront). Be very thorough.

GOAL: Map EVERYTHING to do with Salesforce Einstein / CQuotient recommendations in this repo, including the base SDK in node_modules, to support building "Recently Viewed" (SFCC-83/84).

Investigate and report on:

1. THE EINSTEIN HOOK AND API SURFACE
   - Find the Einstein hook(s): search overrides/app/hooks/ and node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/ for use-einstein / useEinstein.
   - Is there an OVERRIDE of the einstein hook in overrides/, or only the base SDK version? State clearly which.
   - List EVERY method the einstein hook exposes (sendViewProduct, sendViewCategory, sendViewPage, sendClickProduct, sendAddToCart, getRecommendations, getZoneRecommendations, etc.) with its exact signature and what it POSTs/GETs.
   - Find the underlying einstein API client class (likely node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/.../einstein.js or similar). Report its base URL construction, required config, and the exact shape of the recommendations response.
   - CRITICAL: does the SDK expose any way to READ a shopper's recently-viewed products back from Einstein/CQuotient? Look for anything like getRecentlyViewed, a "recently-viewed" recommender name, or a recommender/zone-name parameter. Report exactly what read-back capability exists, if any.

2. CONFIG
   - Read config/default.js Einstein block: einsteinAPI host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction. Quote it.
   - Check config/sit.js, config/dev.js and any other config/*.js for Einstein overrides — specifically whether Einstein is disabled anywhere.
   - Check .env.sample for EINSTEIN_* vars, their scope tag and whether they have values.
   - Check whether the base useEinstein hook honours any `enabled` flag at all.

3. EXISTING CONSUMERS
   - grep the whole of overrides/ for: einstein, Einstein, useEinstein, sendViewProduct, sendViewPage, getRecommendations, RecommendedProducts, recommender, zone.
   - For each hit report file:line and what it does.
   - Is RecommendedProducts (overrides or base) actually rendered anywhere? Trace its consumers.

4. THE USER'S IN-FLIGHT RECENTLY-VIEWED WORK (most important — read these files fully)
   - Find and read everything added by the last 3 commits on this branch. Run: git log --oneline -5 and git show --stat for commits 2449e9f, 387b26a, 0923c82.
   - Find the recently-viewed hook(s) (something like useRecentlyViewed / recently-viewed session gate / PDP view marker) and the ZimmRecentlyViewedRail organism. Read them in full.
   - Report EXACTLY how browsing history is currently being stored (sessionStorage? localStorage? state? an API?), the storage key, the cap on number of items, the dedupe logic, and whether there is any authenticated-vs-guest branch.
   - Report where the rail is currently wired in (which pages).
   - Report whether SFCC-84's "See Full History" page exists yet.
   - Note whether the current implementation touches Einstein AT ALL.

5. DOCS IN REPO
   - grep .docs/ for Einstein, CQuotient, recommendation, recently viewed. Report what .docs/integration/01-sfcc.md says about Einstein (quote it). Note whether a dedicated Einstein integration doc exists.
   - Check .docs/memory/sprintScope.md and projectState.md for anything about Einstein or recently viewed.

6. ALTERNATIVE PERSISTENCE PATHS (for the authenticated cross-session requirement)
   - Does the codebase or SDK have any existing pattern for persisting per-customer data — e.g. customer custom attributes via updateCustomer, a customer product list (wishlist!) via shopper-customers API? Find how the WISHLIST is implemented in this repo/SDK, because a customer product list is the most likely alternative persistence mechanism for cross-device recently-viewed. Report the exact API/hook used and whether list types other than wishlist are supported.

RETURN FORMAT: organised by the six headings above, with concrete file:line references and short verbatim code quotes for the important bits. State clearly what does NOT exist — absence is a finding. Do not modify any file.

21	    constructor({host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction, dnt}) {

35	    _buildBody(params) {
36	        const instanceType_prd = 'prd'
37	        const instanceType_sbx = 'sbx'
38	
39	        const body = {...params}
40	
41	        // The first part of the siteId is the realm
42	        if (this.siteId) {
43	            body.realm = this.siteId.split('-')[0]
44	        }
45	
46	        if (this.isProduction) {
47	            body.instanceType = instanceType_prd
48	        } else {

50	        }
51

55	    /**

57	     */
58	    _constructEinsteinProduct(product) {
59	        // Handle variants for PDP / viewProduct
60	        // Assumes product is a Product object from SCAPI Shopper-Products:
61	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-products?meta=type%3AProduct
62	        if (product.type) {
63	            // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute
64	            if (product.type.variant) {
65	                return {
66	                    id: product.master.masterId,
67	                    price: product.price,
68	                    sku: product.id
69	                }
70	            }
71	
72	            // In case of variation group, send the "altId" and "type" attributes
73	            if (product.type.variationGroup) {
74	                return {
75	                    altId: product.id,
76	                    id: product.master.masterId,
77	                    price: product.price,
78	                    sku: product.id,
79	                    type: 'vgroup'
80	                }
81	            }
82	
83	            // Handle non-variant products, like master, set, bundle, item.
84	            // This code follows the implementation in the plugin_einstein_api.
85	            // https://github.com/SalesforceCommerceCloud/plugin_einstein_api/blob/c8168d5b8e2e34bfb9413da73969d59b0f3adabd/plugin_einstein_api/cartridge/scripts/helpers/RecommendationsHelper.js#L315

87	                id: product.id,
88	                price: product.price
89	            }

94	        // https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/references/shopper-search?meta=type%3AProductSearchHit
95	        if (product.hitType) {

97	                id: product.productId,
98	                sku: product.productId, //TODO: Should we switch this to product.representedProduct.id once we allow non-master products in search results?
99	                altId: '',
100	                altIdType: ''
101	            }
102	        }
103	
104	        // handles non-variants
105	        return {
106	            id: product.id,
107	            sku: '',
108	            altId: '',
109	            altIdType: ''
110	        }

125	        // In case of variant, send the "sku" attribute

128	                id: product.master.masterId,

136	        if (product?.type?.variationGroup) {

139	                quantity: quantity,
140	                price: price,
141	                sku: product.id,
142	                type: 'vgroup',
143	                altId: product.id
144	            }
145	        }

155	    async einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body) {
156	        if (this.dnt !== false) return {}
157	
158	        const headers = {
159	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
160	            'x-cq-client-id': this.einsteinId
161	        }
162	
163	        if (body) {
164	            body = this._buildBody(body)
165	        }
166	
167	        let response
168	        try {
169	            response = await fetch(`${this.host}/v3${endpoint}`, {
170	                method: method,
171	                headers: headers,
172	                ...(body && {
173	                    body: JSON.stringify(body)
174	                })
175	            })
176	        } catch (error) {
177	            logger.error('Einstein request failed', {
178	                namespace: 'useEinstein.einsteinFetch',
179	                additionalProperties: {error: error}
180	            })

438	const useEinstein = () => {
439	    const api = useCommerceApi()
440	    const {effectiveDnt} = useDNT()
441	    const {getTokenWhenReady} = useAccessToken()
442	    const {
443	        app: {einsteinAPI: config = {}}
444	    } = getConfig()
445	    const {host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction} = config
446	
447	    const {getUsidWhenReady} = useUsid()
448	    const {getEncUserIdWhenReady} = useEncUserId()
449	    const {isRegistered} = useCustomerType()
450	
451	    const einstein = useMemo(
452	        () =>
453	            new EinsteinAPI({
454	                host,
455	                einsteinId,
456	                siteId,
457	                isProduction,
458	                dnt: effectiveDnt
459	            }),
460	        [host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction, effectiveDnt]
461	    )
462	    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
463	    const [recommendations, setRecommendations] = useState([])
464	
465	    const fetchRecProductDetails = async (reco) => {
466	        const ids = reco.recs?.map((rec) => rec.id)
467	        if (ids?.length > 0) {
468	            try {
469	                const token = await getTokenWhenReady()
470	                // Fetch the product details for the recommendations
471	                const products = await api.shopperProducts.getProducts({
472	                    parameters: {
473	                        ids: ids.join(','),
474	                        allImages: true,
475	                        perPricebook: true,
476	                        expand: [
477	                            'availability',
478	                            'links',
479	                            'promotions',
480	                            'options',
481	                            'images',
482	                            'prices',
483	                            'variations'
484	                        ]
485	                    },
486	                    headers: {
487	                        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
488	                    }
489	                })
490	                // Einstein is not aware of items that becomes unavailable from BM
491	                // we want to make sure to filter out any recs that is not available
492	                // before merging getProducts data in
493	                const recs = reco.recs
494	                    .filter((rec) => {
495	                        return !!products?.data?.find((product) => product.id === rec.id)
496	                    })
497	                    .map((rec) => {
498	                        const product = products?.data?.find((product) => product.id === rec.id)
499	                        return {
500	                            ...rec,
501	                            ...product,
502	                            productId: rec.id,
503	                            image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt: rec.productName}
504	                        }
505	                    })
506	
507	                // Merge the product detail into the recommendations response
508	                return {
509	                    ...reco,
510	                    recs: recs
511	                }
512	            } catch (error) {
513	                logger.error('Error fetching product details for recommendations', {
514	                    namespace: 'useEinstein.fetchRecProductDetails',
515	                    additionalProperties: {error: error}
516	                })
517	            }
518	        }
519	        return reco
520	    }
521	
522	    const getEventUserParameters = async () => {
523	        return {
524	            cookieId: await getUsidWhenReady(),
525	            userId: isRegistered ? await getEncUserIdWhenReady() : undefined
526	        }
527	    }
528	
529	    return {
530	        isLoading,
531	
532	        recommendations,
533	
534	        async sendViewProduct(...args) {
535	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
536	            return einstein.sendViewProduct(...args.concat(userParameters))
537	        },
538	        async sendViewSearch(...args) {
539	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
540	            return einstein.sendViewSearch(...args.concat(userParameters))
541	        },
542	        async sendClickSearch(...args) {
543	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
544	            return einstein.sendClickSearch(...args.concat(userParameters))
545	        },
546	        async sendViewCategory(...args) {
547	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
548	            return einstein.sendViewCategory(...args.concat(userParameters))
549	        },
550	        async sendClickCategory(...args) {
551	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
552	            return einstein.sendClickCategory(...args.concat(userParameters))
553	        },
554	        async sendViewPage(...args) {
555	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
556	            return einstein.sendViewPage(...args.concat(userParameters))
557	        },
558	        async sendBeginCheckout(...args) {
559	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
560	            return einstein.sendBeginCheckout(...args.concat(userParameters))
561	        },
562	        async sendCheckoutStep(...args) {
563	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
564	            return einstein.sendCheckoutStep(...args.concat(userParameters))
565	        },
566	        async sendViewReco(...args) {
567	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
568	            return einstein.sendViewReco(...args.concat(userParameters))
569	        },
570	        async sendClickReco(...args) {
571	            const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
572	            return einstein.sendClickReco(...args.concat(userParameters))
573	        },
574	        async sendAddToCart(...args) {

576	            return einstein.sendAddToCart(...args.concat(userParameters))
577	        },
578	        async getRecommenders(...args) {
579	            return einstein.getRecommenders(...args)
580	        },
581	        async getRecommendations(recommenderName, products, ...args) {
582	            setIsLoading(true)
583	            try {
584	                const userParameters = await getEventUserParameters()
585	                const reco = await einstein.getRecommendations(
586	                    recommenderName,
587	                    products,
588	                    ...args.concat(userParameters)
589	                )
590	                reco.recommenderName = recommenderName
591	                const recommendations = await fetchRecProductDetails(reco)
592	                setRecommendations(recommendations)
593	            } catch (err) {
594	                logger.error('Error in getRecommendations', {
595	                    namespace: 'useEinstein.getRecommendations',
596	                    additionalProperties: {error: err}
597	                })
598	            } finally {
599	                setIsLoading(false)
600	            }
601	        },

606	                const reco = await einstein.getZoneRecommendations(
607	                    zoneName,

609	                    ...args.concat(userParameters)

612	                setRecommendations(recommendations)

617	                })

619	                setIsLoading(false)

21	   * title out, leaving whatever styling it already carries (e.g. a caller-supplied `Heading`)
22	   * untouched.
23	   */
24	  title: ReactNode;
25	  /**
26	   * Rendered in the exact order received (AC 2: most-recent-first, left to right) — no sorting or
27	   * reordering happens here. Capped to `RECENTLY_VIEWED_RAIL_MAX_ITEMS` regardless of length; see
28	   * that constant's own comment (app/constants/index.ts) for why the cap has to live here rather
29	   * than in the request that produced this array.
30	   */
31	  cards: readonly ZimmProductCardProps[];
32	  /** Href to the SFCC-84 Recently Viewed Full History page. The See-Full-History link only
33	   *  renders when this is provided — see the render body below. */
34	  seeAllHref?: string;
35	  /**
36	   * No default/fallback text is supplied when this is omitted while `seeAllHref` is provided —
37	   * this component owns no copy or intl (see the module docblock), so inventing an English
38	   * fallback here would risk shipping untranslated text on non-English storefronts. In real usage
39	   * the container (A6) is expected to always supply this alongside `seeAllHref`.

47	 * SFCC-83 — the Recently Viewed rail organism (build plan section A5). Purely presentational:
48	 * data arrives as props, no data-fetching, no `useEinstein`, no `useIntl` — see
49	 * .claude/rules/components.md's container/presentational split. The container (A6) is
50	 * responsible for building `cards` (via A3's Einstein-rec-to-card mapper), gating this
51	 * component's visibility (A4's `hasRecentlyViewed`), and supplying `title`/`seeAllLabel` copy.
52	 *
53	 * Structure mirrors Figma exactly: a `header` row (title left, the See-Full-History link right)
54	 * above a horizontally scrollable `group` of `ZimmProductCard`s. No rail-level arrow buttons —
55	 * `ZimmProductCardMedia` already carries its own intra-card carousel arrows, and a second set at

62	 * `variation: 'recentlyViewed'` onto every card itself. In real usage every entry already carries
63	 * that variation by construction (A3's mapper produces `recentlyViewed`-shaped cards, matching

65	 * `ZimmProductCardRecentlyViewedVariation`) — this component trusts that contract rather than
66	 * re-asserting it, consistent with staying purely presentational.

100	            <ZimmProductCard {...card} />

102	        ))}

1	/**
2	 * Maps one Recently Viewed recommendation onto the subset of `ZimmProductCard` props the
3	 * `recentlyViewed` variation (SFCC-83) actually renders.
4	 *
5	 * Input is exactly what `use-einstein.js`'s `fetchRecProductDetails` produces (search that name
6	 * in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js`): an Einstein rec
7	 * merged with its matching Commerce API product, fetched via `getProducts` with `expand:
8	 * ['availability', 'links', 'promotions', 'options', 'images', 'prices', 'variations']` —
9	 * `{...rec, ...product, productId: rec.id, image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt:
10	 * rec.productName}}`.
11	 *
12	 * Modelled on `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts` — no React/react-intl import,
13	 * `formatPrice` injected as a parameter so this module stays independently testable — and on the
14	 * general shape of `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts` (`feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo`, not this
15	 * branch — read for its approach, not imported). Unlike that demo mapper, this is a production
16	 * path: real `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` SDK types are used wherever they exist (AGENTS.md > Type
17	 * Definitions), and only the two fields the SDK doesn't export (`productId`, the flat Einstein
18	 * `image`) are hand-rolled, each with its own why-comment below.
19	 *
20	 * Deliberately narrow scope, stated here rather than left as a silent gap: this mapper only ever
21	 * returns `currentPrice` (an active selling price). It does not attempt was/now sale-price
22	 * detection (`originalPrice`) — that needs `getPriceData`-style pricebook logic
23	 * (`productInfo.ts`'s own `PdpSourcePrice`) that this merged Einstein shape has no equivalent of,
24	 * and the `recentlyViewed` variation renders no price at all today (see
25	 * `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s `recentlyViewed` `VARIATION_CONFIG` row — `showContent: false`).
26	 * Mapping `currentPrice` anyway costs nothing and means a future consumer of this same mapper
27	 * (e.g. a variation that does render price) isn't blocked on this file being revisited.
28	 */
29	import type { ShopperProductsTypes } from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic';
30	import { filterImageGroups } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils';
31	import { productUrlBuilder } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/url';
32	import type { ZimmProductCardBaseProps, ZimmProductCardImage } from '../components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard';
33	
34	/**
35	 * The real Commerce API `Product` (`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`'s own `ShopperProductsTypes.Product`
36	 * — not hand-rolled), plus the two fields `fetchRecProductDetails` bolts on that have no SDK
37	 * equivalent:
38	 */
39	export type RecentlyViewedProduct = ShopperProductsTypes.Product & {
40	  /** Set by `fetchRecProductDetails` to `rec.id`. Guaranteed present and equal to `Product.id`
41	   *  for every entry that function produces (it already filters out any rec with no matching
42	   *  product before this shape exists at all) — read this rather than `.id` only because it's
43	   *  the field the real runtime hook explicitly produces this way. */
44	  productId: string;
45	  /** The same function's own quick single-reference image (Einstein's own `rec.imageUrl`/
46	   *  `rec.productName`), distinct from the full product's own `imageGroups` array below — used
47	   *  as a fallback only when `imageGroups` filtering comes up empty. See `selectPrimaryImage`. */
48	  image?: { disBaseLink?: string; alt?: string };
49	};
50	
51	/** Formats a bare amount for the storefront. Injected so this module stays free of react-intl,
52	 *  mirroring `productInfo.ts`'s own `FormatPrice` shape. */
53	export type FormatPrice = (amount: number, currency: string) => string;
54	
55	/**
56	 * The subset of `ZimmProductCardBaseProps` this mapper populates. Deliberately excludes
57	 * `headingLevel` and `variation` — both are render-context decisions belonging to the container
58	 * step that maps recs through this mapper and renders the rail (SFCC-83's A6 step), which supplies
59	 * `headingLevel` uniformly for every card and adds `variation: 'recentlyViewed'` itself when
60	 * spreading this output into `<ZimmProductCard>` — the rail organism itself (A5) takes already-full
61	 * `ZimmProductCardProps` objects, so variation must already be set before it sees them. A pure data
62	 * mapper choosing a heading level would conflate a data concern with a layout one. Also excludes `hoverImage`/`images` — this
63	 * mapper only ever returns one image (`primaryImage`); see `selectPrimaryImage`'s own docblock
64	 * for why.
65	 */
66	export type RecentlyViewedCard = Pick<
67	  ZimmProductCardBaseProps,
68	  'id' | 'href' | 'name' | 'primaryImage' | 'currentPrice'
69	>;
70	
71	/** The correctly-sized product image view, per AGENTS.md's image-sizing guidance: never serve an
72	 *  arbitrary-sized image at thumbnail size. Named rather than inlined per conventions.md's
73	 *  no-magic-strings rule — this is a real, semantic SFCC image `viewType` key. */
74	const MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE = 'medium';
75	
76	/**
77	 * Resolves the one image this mapper ever returns. `hoverImage`/`images` are never populated —
78	 * SFCC-83 AC 3 asks for "the product's index image" (singular), and the `recentlyViewed`
79	 * variation renders neither a hover-swap nor a gallery (see `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s
80	 * `recentlyViewed` row: `showHoverImageSwap: false`, and its render branch never forwards
81	 * `images` at all).
82	 *
83	 * Prefers `filterImageGroups` at `viewType: 'medium'` (a real, correctly-sized product image) —
84	 * `variationValues` is deliberately empty: a Recently Viewed rec is already one specific product,
85	 * not a search hit needing a variant pick the way `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts`'s own
86	 * `resolveDemoVariant` handles, so that logic does not apply here. Falls back to Einstein's own
87	 * flat `image` field only when that filtering produces nothing usable — see
88	 * `RecentlyViewedProduct.image`'s own comment for what that field is.
89	 *
90	 * @returns `null` when neither source has a usable `src`. `ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt` is
91	 *   required and non-empty, so there is no safe placeholder card to build without a real image —
92	 *   a card with an invented placeholder `src` would need an asset this codebase has no confirmed
93	 *   token or precedent for, so "no usable image" is treated the same as "no usable name" in
94	 *   `selectRecentlyViewedCard` below: a hard gate that yields no card at all. Returning `null`
95	 *   here is the only option that structurally cannot violate the non-empty-`alt` contract, since
96	 *   there is no returned object for `alt` to be empty on.
97	 */
98	const selectPrimaryImage = (product: RecentlyViewedProduct, productName: string): ZimmProductCardImage | null => {
99	  const filteredGroups = filterImageGroups(product.imageGroups ?? [], {
100	    viewType: MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE,
101	    variationValues: {},
102	  }) as ShopperProductsTypes.ImageGroup[];
103	  const [groupImage] = filteredGroups[0]?.images ?? [];
104	
105	  const src = groupImage ? groupImage.disBaseLink || groupImage.link : product.image?.disBaseLink;
106	  if (!src) return null;
107	
108	  // ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt is required and non-empty (unlike base ProductTile's
109	  // decorative alt: '' convention) — mirrors liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts's own fallback exactly.
110	  const alt = (groupImage ? groupImage.alt : product.image?.alt)?.trim() || productName;
111	  return { src, alt };
112	};
113	
114	/**
115	 * @param product - The merged Einstein rec + Commerce API product `fetchRecProductDetails`
116	 *   produces, or `undefined`/`null` while that data is not yet available.
117	 * @param formatPrice - Currency formatter, normally `intl.formatNumber`.
118	 * @returns Props for the `recentlyViewed` `ZimmProductCard` variation, or `null` when the rec has
119	 *   no usable name or no usable image — never a broken card, never a throw.
120	 */
121	export const selectRecentlyViewedCard = (
122	  product: RecentlyViewedProduct | undefined | null,
123	  formatPrice: FormatPrice,
124	): RecentlyViewedCard | null => {
125	  if (!product?.name) return null;
126	
127	  const primaryImage = selectPrimaryImage(product, product.name);
128	  if (!primaryImage) return null;
129	
130	  return {
131	    // Reads productId, not the SDK Product's own `id` — see RecentlyViewedProduct.productId's
132	    // own comment for why (guaranteed equal in practice, but productId is the field the real
133	    // runtime hook explicitly produces this way).
134	    id: product.productId,
135	    href: productUrlBuilder({ id: product.productId }),
136	    name: product.name,
137	    primaryImage,
138	    // No hardcoded fallback currency — if either is absent, skip formatting rather than guess,
139	    // matching productInfo.ts's own "no hardcoded fallback currency" comment.
140	    currentPrice:
141	      typeof product.price === 'number' && product.currency ? formatPrice(product.price, product.currency) : undefined,
142	  };
143	};

=== .docs/integration/01-sfcc.md Einstein lines ===
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/checkout/shopper-login/oauth2/*` | GET, POST                | SLAS authentication and token lifecycle                                                                                                         |
| `/product/shopper-products/v1/*`   | GET                      | Product details, master/variant resolution                                                                                                      |
| `/search/shopper-search/v1/*`      | GET                      | Catalogue search, faceting, sort, suggestions                                                                                                   |
| `/checkout/shopper-baskets/v2/*`   | GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE | Basket lifecycle, line items, shipments, payment instruments                                                                                    |
| `/checkout/shopper-orders/v1/*`    | POST, GET                | Order placement and lookup (SFCC-owned checkouts only)                                                                                          |
| `/customer/shopper-customers/v1/*` | GET, POST, PATCH         | Profile, addresses, saved-payment references                                                                                                    |
| `/pricing/shopper-promotions/v1/*` | GET                      | Active promotions, coupon validation                                                                                                            |
| Einstein recommendations endpoints | GET                      | Personalised recommendations slot. Consent-gated (Didomi purpose TBC) — falls back to a static SFCC merchandising group if consent is not given |

Every request carries the site ID, organisation ID, locale, currency, and SLAS bearer token. PII travels over TLS only. PCI scope is Adyen's — SFCC holds token references only.

## 5. reCAPTCHA on register and login (CRM-008)

- The storefront loads the reCAPTCHA v3 script on register and login forms only — not on any other page — and only after the customer first touches the form, so the script never blocks first paint.
- On submit, the reCAPTCHA token is sent alongside the form data to the MRT layer. The MRT layer verifies the token against Google's `siteverify` endpoint (using the secret key held as the `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY` MRT environment variable) before forwarding the request to SCAPI. The secret key never reaches the browser.
- The site key is set per environment as `RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY` (MRT environment variable, public). The secret key is held as `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY` (MRT environment variable, server-only).
- reCAPTCHA loads on form interaction regardless of consent. **Exception: EU and UK** — in those regions it only loads after Didomi consent, which means a visitor who declines gets no bot protection there.

## 6. Performance and loading strategy

- **HTTP/2** to a single SCAPI host; `<link rel="preconnect">` emitted in the document head.
- **TanStack Query** dedupes in-flight requests. Working defaults: stale time 60 s for catalogue, 30 s for promotions, 0 s for basket (always fresh).
- **SFCC edge cache** for anonymous catalogue traffic; cache keys include site, locale, currency, and customer group.
- **Parallel calls on PDP.** Product, recommendations, and promotions are fetched in parallel — no waterfall.
- **SSR fetches only critical data.** Recommendations and reviews load client-side after hydration.
- **Field projection.** SCAPI `fields=` parameters are used where supported to reduce payload size.

## 7. Multi-region behaviour

SFCC site IDs and Business Manager locale IDs verified against bkzk-002 Business Manager (2026-06-13):

| Failure                                       | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SLAS unavailable                              | Storefront cannot mint a guest token and is non-operational. Show a maintenance message. P1 incident.                                                                           |
| SCAPI catalogue 5xx                           | TanStack Query retries three times with exponential backoff. On final failure, show the last cached payload if available; otherwise show an error state with a "Try again" CTA. |
| SCAPI basket 5xx during add-to-cart           | Inline error toast. The user's intent stays in client state so a retry resends the same request.                                                                                |
| Order placement 5xx after Adyen authorisation | Hard error — the order cannot fail silently. The customer sees an explicit error with a contact reference and ops is alerted.                                                   |
| Einstein recommendations 5xx                  | Hide the slot or fall back to a static merchandising group.                                                                                                                     |
| SLAS token refresh fails                      | Force re-login. The basket is preserved on the guest token until the customer completes checkout.                                                                               |
| TSOB 409 (rapid storefront switch)            | Retry after 3 seconds. Do not re-login the customer — the existing session is still valid on the origin channel.                                                                |
| reCAPTCHA fails to load or token rejected     | Block the register/login submit, show a "please retry" message, and offer a contact-support path after two failures.                                                            |

## 9. Security and privacy

I have a complete picture. Report below.

---

# 1. THE EINSTEIN HOOK AND API SURFACE

## Override status — clear answer

**There is NO override of the Einstein hook.** `overrides/app/hooks/` contains 15 hooks (all `useCamelCase.ts` custom ones) — no `use-einstein.js`, no `useEinstein.ts`. `find overrides -iname "*einstein*"` returns nothing. Every consumer imports the base SDK version directly:

```
overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx:81
overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:49
overrides/app/pages/product-list/index.tsx:77
overrides/app/pages/home/index.tsx:20
    import useEinstein from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein';
```

Sole implementation: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js` (626 lines, retail-react-app 10.0.0). It exports both `EinsteinAPI` (the class, named export, line 20) and `useEinstein` (default, line 438).

## Every method the hook exposes

The hook returns an object (lines 529–622). All `send*` methods append a `userParameters` object (`{cookieId, userId}`) as a final argument before delegating to the class.

| Hook method | Class signature | HTTP | Endpoint (after `${host}/v3`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sendViewProduct` | `(product, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/viewProduct` |
| `sendViewSearch` | `(searchText, searchResults, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/viewSearch` |
| `sendClickSearch` | `(searchText, product, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/clickSearch` |
| `sendViewCategory` | `(category, searchResults, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/viewCategory` |
| `sendClickCategory` | `(category, product, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/clickCategory` |
| `sendViewPage` | `(path, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/viewPage` |
| `sendBeginCheckout` | `(basket, args = {})` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/beginCheckout` |
| `sendCheckoutStep` | `(stepName, stepNumber, basket, args = {})` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/checkoutStep` |
| `sendViewReco` | `(recommenderDetails, products, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/viewReco` |
| `sendClickReco` | `(recommenderDetails, product, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/clickReco` |
| `sendAddToCart` | `(items, args)` | POST | `/activities/${siteId}/addToCart` |
| `getRecommenders` | `()` | **GET** | `/personalization/recommenders/${siteId}` |
| `getRecommendations` | `(recommenderName, products, ...args)` | POST | `/personalization/recs/${siteId}/${recommenderName}` |
| `getZoneRecommendations` | `(zoneName, products, ...args)` | POST | `/personalization/${siteId}/zones/${zoneName}/recs` |

Plus two state values: `isLoading` (boolean) and `recommendations` (initialised to `[]` but overwritten with an **object** — see the dead-check note in §3).

Note the two `get*Recommendations` hook wrappers **return `undefined`** — they set React state rather than returning the data (lines 581–621).

## The API client class — base URL, config, DNT gate

`EinsteinAPI` constructor (`use-einstein.js:21`): `{host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction, dnt}`.

URL construction and the transport gate, `einsteinFetch` (lines 155–199):

```js
async einsteinFetch(endpoint, method, body) {
    if (this.dnt !== false) return {}

    const headers = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-cq-client-id': this.einsteinId
    }
    ...
    response = await fetch(`${this.host}/v3${endpoint}`, {...})
```

`_buildBody` (lines 35–53) decorates every POST body with `realm` (`siteId.split('-')[0]`) and `instanceType` (`'prd'` if `isProduction` else `'sbx'`). Response is passed through `keysToCamel`. **Any non-ok response silently returns `{}`** (line 184–186) — no error surfaced to the UI.

### ⚠️ The DNT gate is the single biggest live risk for this feature

`if (this.dnt !== false) return {}` means Einstein is a **no-op unless `effectiveDnt` is strictly `false`**. And:

- `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants.js:216` — `export const DEFAULT_DNT_STATE = true`
- `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx:196` — `defaultDnt={DEFAULT_DNT_STATE}`
- `node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/auth/index.js:330-341` — `effectiveDnt` = the `dw_dnt` cookie if set, **otherwise `defaultDnt`** (i.e. `true`).

So with no `dw_dnt=0` cookie, **every Einstein call in this app returns `{}` and the Recently Viewed rail renders nothing**. There is no `updateDnt` / `dw_dnt` / Didomi consent wiring anywhere in `overrides/` (grep returns zero hits). This is worth confirming in a running browser before assuming the rail is broken for any other reason.

## Recommendations response shape

Two layers. The raw Einstein response (camelised) carries `recs[]`, `recoUUID`, `displayMessage`. Then `fetchRecProductDetails` (`use-einstein.js:465-520`) enriches it:

```js
const ids = reco.recs?.map((rec) => rec.id)
...
const products = await api.shopperProducts.getProducts({
    parameters: {ids: ids.join(','), allImages: true, perPricebook: true,
        expand: ['availability','links','promotions','options','images','prices','variations']},
    ...
})
// filters out recs with no matching product (Einstein doesn't know about BM-unavailable items)
return {...rec, ...product, productId: rec.id, image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt: rec.productName}}
```

Final consumed shape: `{recs: MergedProduct[], recoUUID, displayMessage, recommenderName}` where `recommenderName` is bolted on **only in `getRecommendations`** (line 590), **not** in `getZoneRecommendations` — an upstream inconsistency that affects `sendViewReco`/`sendClickReco` payloads on zone-based rails.

## CRITICAL: read-back of a shopper's recently-viewed products

**There is no dedicated read-back API. The `viewed-recently-einstein` recommender IS the read-back, and it is the only one.**

Evidence of absence:
- `grep -rni "recentlyviewed|recently-viewed|recently_viewed"` across `node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/` → **zero hits**.
- Same grep across `node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/` → **zero hits**.
- Across `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/` → only the two constants below and i18n message IDs. No `getRecentlyViewed`, no shopper-context recently-viewed field, nothing.

The only mechanism is the recommender name (`constants.js:153-163`):

```js
// Einstein recommender constants used in <RecommendedProducts/>
export const EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS = {
    ADD_TO_CART_MODAL: 'pdp-similar-items',
    CART_RECENTLY_VIEWED: 'viewed-recently-einstein',
    CART_MAY_ALSO_LIKE: 'product-to-product-einstein',
    PDP_COMPLETE_SET: 'complete-the-set',
    PDP_MIGHT_ALSO_LIKE: 'pdp-similar-items',
    PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED: 'viewed-recently-einstein',
    ...
}
```

`CART_RECENTLY_VIEWED` and `PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` are **the identical string**. Read-back is therefore: `POST /v3/personalization/recs/{siteId}/viewed-recently-einstein` with `{cookieId: usid, userId: encUserId|undefined, realm, instanceType}`. Personalisation keys off `cookieId`/`userId`, which is exactly why the authenticated cross-device case is expected to work server-side — and why it cannot be verified client-side.

Also relevant: **`getRecommendations` accepts no `limit`/`count` parameter** in the SDK signature. `args` is spread into the body so a caller *could* pass one, but nothing in the repo does, and the team's own note (`overrides/app/constants/index.ts:11-16`) states the endpoint "does not itself honour a requested `limit`" — hence the client-side cap.

---

# 2. CONFIG

## `config/default.js:140-149` — verbatim

```js
    // Einstein api config
    einsteinAPI: {
      host: 'https://api.cquotient.com',
      einsteinId: '1ea06c6e-c936-4324-bcf0-fada93f83bb1',
      siteId: process.env.EINSTEIN_API_SITE_ID,
      // Flag Einstein activities as coming from a production environment.
      // By setting this to true, the Einstein activities generated by the environment will appear
      // in production environment reports
      isProduction: false,
    },
```

`einsteinId` is the **stock PWA Kit demo client ID** (unchanged from the base template), and `isProduction: false` is hardcoded — never overridden per environment, so even production would report as `sbx`.

## Per-environment configs — no Einstein overrides anywhere

`grep -rn -i einstein config/` matches **only `config/default.js`**. `config/sit.js` and `config/dev.js` both do `{...defaultConfig, ssrParameters: {...}}` and touch only `proxyConfigs`. Same for `production.js`, `staging.js`, `uat.js`, `test.js`.

**Einstein is not disabled anywhere by config.** The only kill-switch in the whole system is the DNT gate described in §1.

## `.env.sample:94-96` — verbatim

```

# mrt:true
EINSTEIN_API_SITE_ID=aaij-MobileFirst
```

Scope tag `scope:tier`, `mrt:true`, **and it has a value committed** (`aaij-MobileFirst` — the Salesforce demo site, not a Zimmermann site).

Across the real env files:

| File | `EINSTEIN_API_SITE_ID` |
|---|---|
| `.env` | `aaij-MobileFirst` |
| `.env.dev` | `aaij-MobileFirst` |
| `.env.uat` | `aaij-MobileFirst` |
| `.env.test` | `aaij-MobileFirst` |
| `.env.sit` | **empty** |

An empty `siteId` breaks both the URL path (`/personalization/recs//viewed-recently-einstein`) and `_buildBody`'s `realm` derivation. **Einstein is effectively non-functional on SIT, staging and prod as configured.**

## Does the base hook honour an `enabled` flag?

**No.** `use-einstein.js:442-445` destructures only `{host, einsteinId, siteId, isProduction}` from `app.einsteinAPI`. There is no `enabled`, no `isEnabled`, no feature flag of any kind — in the hook, the class, or the config schema. The DNT check is the only conditional. (Contrast `ACTIVE_DATA_ENABLED` at `constants.js:171` and `STORE_LOCATOR_IS_ENABLED`, which *do* exist for other features — so the absence here is a real gap, not an oversight in my search.)

## Is `RecommendedProducts` actually rendered? Yes — five live call sites

**`RecommendedProducts` IS overridden** at `overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx` (371 lines, TS port of the base `.jsx`).

Consumers:

```

# 4. THE IN-FLIGHT RECENTLY-VIEWED WORK

Branch `feature/SFCC-83-84_recently-viewed`, **working tree clean** (`git status --short` empty — everything is committed).

```

## ⭐ How browsing history is stored — the headline answer

**Browsing history is NOT stored locally at all. The product list comes entirely from Einstein.**

`sessionStorage` holds exactly **one boolean flag** — never a product list, never IDs.

`overrides/app/hooks/useRecentlyViewedGate.ts`:

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| **Storage medium** | `sessionStorage` — for a boolean gate only |
| **Storage key** | `'zimm-recently-viewed'` (`RECENTLY_VIEWED_SESSION_KEY`, line 10) |
| **Stored value** | the literal string `'true'` (line 24) |
| **Product list source** | Einstein `viewed-recently-einstein` recommender, via `getRecommendations` |
| **Cap on items** | `RECENTLY_VIEWED_RAIL_MAX_ITEMS = 5`, enforced **client-side** at `zimmRecentlyViewedRail/index.tsx:79` (`cards.slice(0, …)`) |
| **Dedupe logic** | **None in this repo.** Ordering and dedupe are entirely Einstein's — `index.tsx:78` "A slice, never a sort — order is otherwise untouched (AC 2)" |
| **Auth vs guest branch** | Yes — `hasRecentlyViewed = sessionFlagIsSet \|\| isRegistered`, via `useCustomerType()` (line 59, 70) |

The gate, verbatim (lines 58–74):

```ts
export const useRecentlyViewedGate = (): boolean => {
  const { isRegistered } = useCustomerType();
  const [hasRecentlyViewed, setHasRecentlyViewed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let sessionFlagIsSet = false;
    try {
      sessionFlagIsSet = sessionStorage.getItem(RECENTLY_VIEWED_SESSION_KEY) !== null;
    } catch { sessionFlagIsSet = false; }
    setHasRecentlyViewed(sessionFlagIsSet || isRegistered);
  }, [isRegistered]);

  return hasRecentlyViewed;
};
```

Both reader and writer are `try/catch`-wrapped for Safari private browsing. SSR-safe by returning `false` until the effect resolves.

Why the gate exists at all (docblock, lines 32-36): *"Einstein's `viewed-recently-einstein` recommender always returns a two-product baseline for a visitor with zero real history, so `recs.length === 0` never fires."*

**Known residual, documented at lines 46-48:** a *registered* shopper who has genuinely never viewed anything still sees Einstein's two-product baseline.

## The write side — one line on PDP

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:58` imports `markProductViewed`; `:819`, inside the existing Einstein `useEffect`:

```ts
    if (product) markProductViewed();
  }, [product]);
```

## The rail organism

`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedRail/index.tsx` (106 lines) — purely presentational, no `useEinstein`, no `useIntl`, no data fetching. Props: `{title: ReactNode, cards: readonly ZimmProductCardProps[], seeAllHref?: string, seeAllLabel?: string}`. Renders `[data-testid="recently-viewed-rail"]` → header (title + optional link) → `[data-testid="recently-viewed-rail-group"]` of `ZimmProductCard`s. Returns `null` when `visibleCards.length === 0`. Companions: `zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts` (166 lines, registered at `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts:38,80`), `index.test.tsx` (159 lines), `index.stories.tsx` (118 lines).

## The mapper

`overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.ts` — `selectRecentlyViewedCard(product, formatPrice)` → `{id, href, name, primaryImage, currentPrice} | null`. Prefers `filterImageGroups` at `viewType: 'medium'`, falls back to Einstein's flat `image.disBaseLink`. Returns `null` (hard gate, no broken card) when there's no usable name or image. Deliberately omits `headingLevel`/`variation` (container's decision) and `originalPrice` (no pricebook data in the merged shape).

## Where the rail is wired in

`overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx:302-339` — a single branch inside the shared container:

```tsx
if (recommender === EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED) {
    if (!hasRecentlyViewed) { return null; }
    const cards: ZimmProductCardProps[] = (recommendations?.recs ?? [])
      .map((rec: RecentlyViewedProduct) => selectRecentlyViewedCard(rec, formatPrice))
      .filter((card): card is RecentlyViewedCard => card !== null)
      .map((card) => ({...card, headingLevel: 'h3', variation: 'recentlyViewed'}));

    return (
      <Box ref={ref} {...(props as BoxProps)}>
        <ZimmRecentlyViewedRail title={title || recommendations?.displayMessage} cards={cards} />
      </Box>
    );
}
```

Because `PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED === CART_RECENTLY_VIEWED === 'viewed-recently-einstein'`, this **one branch lights up both surfaces**: PDP (via the relative-import fix) and the base Cart page (via the normal resolver). The `<Box ref>` wrapper preserves `useIntersectionObserver` impression tracking, since the rail has no `forwardRef`.

The gate is called **unconditionally at line 173**, above the early return, correctly respecting rules of hooks.

## SFCC-84 "See Full History" page — does NOT exist

- No route: `grep -i "recently|history" overrides/app/routes.tsx` → **zero hits**.
- No page directory under `overrides/app/pages/`.

**Yes — comprehensively.** Contrary to a "sessionStorage-only" reading, Einstein is the *sole* source of the product data. `sessionStorage` supplies only the visibility gate. The product list, its ordering, its dedupe, and its cross-session/cross-device persistence are all Einstein's `viewed-recently-einstein` recommender, reached through the unmodified base `useEinstein` hook.

# 6. ALTERNATIVE PERSISTENCE PATHS

## Customer product lists — the strongest candidate, and it is already in use

`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-wish-list.js` (the whole hook):

```js
export const useWishList = ({listId = ''} = {}) => {
    const {data: customer} = useCurrentCustomer()
    const {customerId} = customer || {}
    const createCustomerProductList = useShopperCustomersMutation('createCustomerProductList')
    const {data: productLists, ...restOfQuery} = useCustomerProductLists(
        {parameters: {customerId}},
        {
            onSuccess: (data) => {
                if (!data.total) {
                    createCustomerProductList.mutate({
                        parameters: {customerId},
                        // we only use one type of product lists for now
                        body: {type: 'wish_list'}
                    })
                }
            },
            enabled: onClient && Boolean(customerId)
        }
    )
    const wishLists = productLists?.data?.filter((list) => list.type === 'wish_list') || []
    ...
}
```

**Exact API/hooks used:**
- Query: `useCustomerProductLists({parameters: {customerId}})` from `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`
- Mutations: `useShopperCustomersMutation('createCustomerProductList' | 'createCustomerProductListItem' | 'deleteCustomerProductListItem')`
- Underlying: SCAPI `shopper-customers` — `/customer/shopper-customers/v1/*` (documented at `.docs/integration/01-sfcc.md:76`)

**Are other list types supported? YES.** `node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.cjs.d.ts:33795`:

```ts
type CustomerProductListTypeEnum = "wish_list" | "gift_registry" | "shopping_list" | "custom_1" | "custom_2" | "custom_3";
```

**`custom_1` / `custom_2` / `custom_3` are first-class, SDK-typed list types with zero consumers in this repo.** The base hook's own comment — `// we only use one type of product lists for now` — confirms the restriction to `wish_list` is a base-template choice, not a platform limit. A `custom_1` list is a directly viable per-customer, cross-device recently-viewed store using the identical mutation surface already proven in this codebase.

Item body shape (already used at `overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx:241-247`):

```ts
body: { quantity: 1, productId: product.productId, public: false, priority: 1, type: 'product' }
```

`priority` is a plausible recency-ordering carrier; `public: false` keeps the list private.

## Customer custom attributes (`c_*` via `updateCustomer`) — no precedent in this repo

`grep -rn "updateCustomer|c_recently|customAttributes" overrides/` returns only `updateCustomerForBasket` (`overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx`… actually `_app/index.tsx:244,265`), which is a **basket** mutation, unrelated to customer profile attributes. There is **no `useShopperCustomersMutation('updateCustomer')` anywhere in `overrides/`**, and no `c_`-prefixed custom-attribute read or write pattern to follow. Viable on the platform, but it would be a from-scratch pattern here — and it needs SFCC-side custom attribute definitions on the Customer object, i.e. a backend dependency the product-list route avoids entirely.

## Summary of what does NOT exist

- No override of `use-einstein` — base SDK only.
- No `getRecentlyViewed` or any recently-viewed read API in `commerce-sdk-react` or `commerce-sdk-isomorphic`. The recommender name is the only path.
- No `enabled` flag on the Einstein config; DNT is the only gate — and it defaults to `true`, which disables Einstein entirely.
- No `limit`/`count` parameter honoured by the recommender; the cap of 5 is client-side.
- No Einstein overrides in any per-environment config; `EINSTEIN_API_SITE_ID` is **empty** in `.env.sit`, `.env.prod`, `.env.staging`.
- No cart page override — Cart reaches the branch via the base page and the resolver.
- No SFCC-84 route, page, or `seeAllHref` wiring — the rail's link is built and tested but never rendered.
- No dedicated Einstein integration doc; no `sprintScope.md` entry for Einstein or SFCC-83/84.
- No local storage of the product list, no dedupe logic, no ordering logic — all delegated to Einstein.
- No `custom_1`/`custom_2`/`custom_3` product list usage, and no `updateCustomer` custom-attribute pattern, despite both being SDK-supported.
